points.description: Gives a first correct use of a laser from the model answer, e.g. cutting or welding, medical surgery, optical fibre communication, or laser printing. Equivalent wording earns the mark.

Gives a second correct use of a laser that is different from the first, from the same list. Repeating the first use, or giving a non-use, earns nothing. Cutting and welding are listed together in the model answer, so they count as one use between them.
